failures.cause: DRAM controller keys were int in freshly parsed data and str after JSON reference serialization, causing a false identity mismatch.
failures.fix: Canonical decimal-string controller keys at parse construction.

failures.cause: Fixture used a non-exported bank counter name.
failures.fix: Perturb the guaranteed exported oo_new_misses field in the already parsed control for calibration rejection.

failures.cause: Unanchored marker assertion counted equal signs in a source comment; diff --check caught remaining markers before compilation.
failures.fix: Anchor to complete conflict-marker lines and retain both exact additions; exact-union source audit passes.

failures.cause: Pair fixture prime() adds direct frontend seed retirements outside LDST; its population cannot equal pipeline retirements.
failures.fix: Retain strict full-input population equality. Actual64SM two-generation fixture without synthetic prime passes; primed pair is now a rejecting negative.

failures.cause: Core CMake export of compile_commands was not enabled; subsequent metadata assumed a C compiler although project enables only CXX.
failures.fix: Enable compile-command metadata without changing flags/binaries; record actual enabled CXX compiler; frozen private ELF bytes must remain identical on metadata reentry.

failures.cause: Adapted reference qualifier labelled preview CTests with core=X2 although the receipt was for an uncommitted reviewed delta.
failures.fix: Use core_base=X2 and explicit uncommitted AE or AC/AE union source identity. Raw logs and all test results preserved.

failures.cause: Draft implementation anchored first PSI qualification to the admission timestamp, which could defer the first runtime observation.
failures.fix: Make the first runtime observation immediately qualified, then retain three observations >=30s apart, exactly matching the retained rule. Added directed1/31/61s CPU tests. No threshold changes.
